items.solution: $48 = 2^{4}\cdot 3$ and $60 = 2^{2}\cdot 3\cdot 5$; take the lowest power of each shared prime: $2^{2}\cdot 3 = 12$.

items.body: Find the lowest common multiple of $12$ and $18$.
